verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips or any other tracking devices. Health authorities confirm their purpose is to stimulate an immune response against the virus.
verdicts.reasoning_en: An overwhelming consensus of evidence from multiple TIER_1 sources, including the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Indonesian government agencies, and independent fact-checkers, confirms that COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips. Experts also note the physical impossibility of injecting a microchip through a standard vaccine needle. The claim is a widely debunked conspiracy theory.
